newsitem.title: USA: Oilex buys 28 wells in Texas.
newsitem.headline: Oilex buys 28 wells in Texas.

text.p: Oilex Inc said on Monday it has acquired 28 additional wells in the Prolific Permian Basin with an estimated one million barrels of remaining recoverable oil.
The wells, which were acquired from Xeric Oil & Gas Inc, a private company based in Midland, Texas, are contiguous to Oilex's Scurry County, Texas, wells in the Revilo unit.

Oilex said it has begun salvage operations to remove all downhole tubing, rods, pumps and surface pump jacks. Once salvage operations are complete, Oilex said it will use its portable swabbing units and swab the oil from the wells daily.
